terrain.notes: ponds, cliffs and other map pieces larger than one chip

object.notes: trees, signs and props that stand on the map

character.notes: one charset cell; feet on the bottom row, about 16 pixels wide

style.genre: top-down fantasy JRPG in the style of classic RPG Maker 2000/2003 maps
style.mood: bright, friendly countryside; chibi characters with big heads and readable faces
style.notes: Characters face the camera with heads about half their height. Tiles carry soft texture without outlines; characters and props have a 1-pixel dark outline. At most three shades per material.
